Temporal focus:
T1. Historical observation [YES] — references top IB ranking for 3rd consecutive year
T2. Forward-looking immediate [YES] — hires onboarding July–September 2025
T3. Longterm development [YES] — strategic middle-market expansion initiative

Synopsis:
BofA is scaling its middle-market investment banking division with 9 senior hires (8 MDs + 1 Vice Chair) across major US cities, drawing talent from Lazard, Rothschild, JPMorgan, and BMO Capital Markets. The push targets growing demand from mid-market corporates and family businesses, particularly across Midwest, Southeast, Texas/Southwest, and Florida. BofA cites sustained market share growth and a 3-year consecutive top IB ranking among global commercial banking clients.
